cases.question: 青禾2026年8月的创建订单数、有效订单数和净销售额分别是多少？按下单日期统计，全门店汇总，净销售额保留分。

actual.sql:
SELECT
  SUM(1) AS order_count
  , SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_order_count
  , SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END) AS net_sales_cents
FROM "data"."main"."orders_enriched" orders_semantic_src_10000
WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
actual.answer: 在青禾当前测试数据范围内，按订单下单日期统计2026年8月（8月1日至8月31日）、全门店汇总：创建订单数为32单，有效订单数为27单，净销售额为100300分（即1003.00元）。口径上，创建订单数按订单号计一次并包含取消单；有效订单数仅计实付金额减退款金额大于零的已支付订单，取消及全额退款不计；净销售额为已支付订单实付减退款后的合计，取消单不计，并按原订单下单日期归属，金额单位为分。

cases.question: 青禾2026年8月只看成交门店编号S01，列出观测期首购会员数、观测期首单数、观测期首单净销售额、观测期后续购买订单数。先在完整覆盖历史内确定各账户首笔有效订单，再按日期和成交门店筛选；金额保留分。

actual.sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT first_buyer_count) AS first_buyer_count
  , SUM(first_order_count) AS first_order_count
  , SUM(first_order_sales_cents) AS first_order_sales_cents
  , SUM(repeat_order_count) AS repeat_order_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    store_id AS store
    , CASE WHEN valid_order_seq = 1 THEN member_id ELSE NULL END AS first_buyer_count
    , CASE WHEN valid_order_seq = 1 THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END AS first_order_sales_cents
    , CASE WHEN valid_order_seq = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS first_order_count
    , CASE WHEN valid_order_seq >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS repeat_order_count
  FROM "data"."main"."orders_enriched" orders_semantic_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_7
WHERE store in ('S01')
actual.answer: 统计范围为青禾当前已加载的CRM会员账户，数据覆盖2024-09-01至2026-09-01；查询窗口为2026年8月，并已按成交门店编号S01筛选。口径为：先在整个测试覆盖历史内确定各账户第一笔有效订单，再筛选落入2026年8月且成交门店为S01的首购账户和首单；后续购买订单数统计各账户第二笔及以后的有效订单中，按订单日期落入2026年8月且成交门店为S01的订单数。结果为：观测期首购会员数3个账户，观测期首单数3单，观测期首单净销售额7,400.00分，观测期后续购买订单数10单。限制：首购口径限于测试覆盖历史，不代表终身首购；后续购买订单数不是月内复购人数。

cases.question: 青禾2026年7月和8月两个完整自然月（2026-07-01含至2026-09-01不含），全门店按月分别列出月内购买会员数、月内复购会员数、月内复购率，不合并月份，复购率保留小数比例。

actual.sql:
WITH sma_10001_cte AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', month_date) AS metric_time__month
    , member_id AS __monthly_buyer_count
    , CASE WHEN valid_order_count >= 2 THEN member_id ELSE NULL END AS __monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM "data"."main"."member_month_activity" member_month_activity_semantic_src_10000
)

SELECT
  COALESCE(subq_8.metric_time__month, subq_14.metric_time__month) AS metric_time__month
  , MAX(subq_8.monthly_buyer_count) AS monthly_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_8.monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  , MAX(CAST(subq_14.monthly_repeat_buyer_count AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(subq_14.monthly_buyer_count, 0) AS DOUBLE)) AS monthly_repeat_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    metric_time__month
    , COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_buyer_count) AS monthly_buyer_count
    , COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM sma_10001_cte
  WHERE metric_time__month BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY
    metric_time__month
) subq_8
FULL OUTER JOIN (
  SELECT
    metric_time__month
    , COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count
    , COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_buyer_count) AS monthly_buyer_count
  FROM sma_10001_cte
  WHERE metric_time__month BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY
    metric_time__month
) subq_14
ON
  subq_8.metric_time__month = subq_14.metric_time__month
GROUP BY
  COALESCE(subq_8.metric_time__month, subq_14.metric_time__month)
actual.answer: 按CRM会员账户统计，范围为2026-07-01（含）至2026-09-01（不含），全门店口径，按完整自然月分别展示，不合并月份，人数不可跨月直接加总。2026年7月：月内购买会员数11个账户，月内复购会员数1个账户，月内复购率9.09%（小数比例0.0909）。2026年8月：月内购买会员数15个账户，月内复购会员数12个账户，月内复购率80.00%（小数比例0.8000）。
